patients_per_day.source: UNSOURCED: scenarios.BASE_VOLUME, a Monday assumption (NHAMCS has no per-ED volume)

source: Calibrated by scripts/calibrate.py (full mode) against NHAMCS 2022: urgent (triage 1-3) median WAITTIME and the LWBS share, PATWT-weighted, with real-data admission and care times (models/patient_flow/admission_lookup.json). NHAMCS has no bed or staff counts, so capacity is FITTED, not measured.

method.search_grid_source: UNSOURCED: candidate range chosen by the team
method.not_saturated_rule: average peak bed occupancy under 95% (UNSOURCED design rule)
method.loss: |sim urgent median wait - real| / real + |sim LWBS - real| / real (+10 if saturated)

fit.quantity: admitted to hospital, % of triaged visits

preset_volume_shares.source: UNSOURCED: illustrative volume shares (30% / 60% / 100% of the reference). Small and Medium are NOT calibrated.
